scripts.package:du-an: npm run check:firebase-config && npm run build:du-an && node -e "var fs=require('fs'),p='dist-du-an/firebase-config.js';if(!fs.existsSync(p)||/YOUR_API_KEY/.test(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'))){console.error('dist-du-an thieu firebase-config.js hop le');process.exit(1)}" && tar -a -cf du-an.zip -C dist-du-an .
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:photo-retention: npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only functions:purgeExpiredPhotos,storage && node scripts/apply-storage-lifecycle.cjs
scripts.apk: npm run build:app && npx cap sync android && node scripts/assemble-apk.cjs
scripts.android: npm run build:app && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
